categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies src/wallet/wallet.cpp and functional wallet tests.
categories.rationale: Fixes a wallet state inconsistency where upgrading a temporary coin lock to persistent fails to update the in-memory entry, leaving a stale lock in the database after the output is spent and the wallet restarted (issue #36304). The bug causes confusing ghost locked UTXOs across restarts under a specific sequence of RPC calls, making this a worthwhile but deferrable correctness fix.
